name: @przeslijmi/real-fake-data-playwright
description: Playwright fixtures for Real Fake Data — 327 seeded, realistic test-data generators plus a compose() method that seeds a whole nested dataset in one call: person & company names across 27 EU countries, the United States and Canada, one-call whole people and whole companies (name + national register/tax/VAT numbers) for every EU member state, national identifiers and VAT/company numbers (NIR, codice fiscale, DNI/NIE, CPR, personnummer, BSN, USt-IdNr, SIREN, CVR, KvK, …), vehicle registration plates for all 27 EU countries plus the United States and Canada, product & service offerings (localized name, price in EUR/USD/CAD, and NACE industry) for all 27 EU countries, the United States and Canada, the full Polish national set (PESEL, NIP, REGON, IBAN, KRS, addresses, ID cards, passports, driving licences), synthetic ID generators (UUID, ULID, Nano ID, MongoDB ObjectId, auto-increment sequences), weighted enum & object pickers, custom-regex patterns, emails, and lorem ipsum.
